lyrics:
[Intro: horn stabs, guitar lick, driving drums]

[Verse 1: commanding, the backing singers answer]
I've been talking since you walked in (ooh)
You've been nodding at your chin (ooh)
I told you twice about my day
You said "uh-huh" and looked away

[Chorus: lead and backing singers trading]
All I'm asking (ooh)
Is for you to listen (just a minute)
When I'm talking (just a minute)
Put it down (put it down, put it down)

[Verse 2: commanding, more heat]
I don't need you to fix a thing (ooh)
I don't need flowers, I don't need a ring (ooh)
I need two ears and a little time
You give me yours, I'll give you mine

[Chorus: lead and backing singers trading]
All I'm asking (ooh)
Is for you to listen (just a minute)
When I'm talking (just a minute)
Put it down (put it down, put it down)

[Saxophone Solo: tenor sax, gritty, eight bars]

[Break: band stops, spelled out over drums only]
L-I-S-T-E-N
Say it back to me again
L-I-S-T-E-N
Ears before your mouth, my friend

[Vamp: full band, backing singers rapid-fire, lead ad-libbing]
(Hear me out, hear me out, hear me out, hear me out)
A little listening
(Just a minute, just a minute)
Oh, is that so hard?
(Hear me out, hear me out, hear me out, hear me out)

[Outro: vamp continues, fast fade]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 115 BPM, 4/4, C major. A hard-driving, strutting soul groove. Proud, sharp and impossible to argue with.

VOICE: A woman with a commanding, gospel-trained voice: huge, bright and completely in control, with shouts, slides and growls. Three backing singers answer her with tight 'ooh's and short phrases, then fire off a repeated phrase very fast in the vamp.

INSTRUMENTS: A punchy horn section (trumpets and saxophones). A stinging electric guitar lick. A driving drum kit with a snare on the backbeat and a busy hi-hat. A fat, walking electric bass. Piano hammering chords. A gritty tenor saxophone for the solo. Tambourine.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, horns and guitar. 0:08 Verse 1. 0:28 Chorus 1. 0:42 Verse 2. 1:02 Chorus 2. 1:16 Saxophone solo. 1:32 Break: the band stops and the word is spelled out over drums. 1:48 Vamp, with the backing singers' rapid phrase and the lead ad-libbing. 2:14 Outro, the vamp fading quickly by 2:28.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Late-1960s soul cut live in the studio: raw, tight and loud, horns and voice in front, everything recorded together.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The spelling at 1:32, with the band stopped.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The thing demanded is attention, in an age when nobody looks up. 'I don't need you to fix a thing' is the line people in long relationships recognise instantly.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Irritation, authority, triumph.
